name: Scatter and lock
look: One photograph is cut into a grid of big live pieces scattered through real 3D space; the scroll flies them home from the centre out into a gapped contact sheet, snaps them shut, lets the poster's word arrive whole and grows the finished picture to full bleed. It opens a showreel, a body of work, a brand mark or a chapter on how a thing is made, from one strong picture.
reduced: The finished composition: the markup as the page writes it, nothing moving.
phone: The same assembly on a 3x4 grid over the 4:5 crop, the headline held at the top until the hand-off; hold 1.8.
place: In the middle, as the door to the work or the showcase. Its last frame is the picture at full bleed, so the next section can carry on from it: a reel that opens on the same frame, or the picture held while the next section rises over it. Once per page.
content: One landscape photograph, 16:9 at 1920 and 3200px (it ends at about 1.55x), with one strong subject near the centre, texture in every part of the frame (moss, water, rock, foliage: every shard must read as a piece of a photograph, not a grey square), mid to light in tone; plus a 4:5 crop at 1000 and 1600px for phones. Served with CORS and never lazy-loaded. A headline of two lines; an optional caption of up to 24 words; an optional poster word of 12 characters or fewer and a short corner note on the poster (both arrive whole after the lock, never cut into the pieces). Without one picture strong enough to be the whole screen, redraw.
options: mode 'assemble' | 'explode' (the poster shatters at the end; never as the first section); hold 1.8 (1.5-4); phoneHold 1.8 (1.5-3); scrub 0.6 (0-0.8); cols 5 and rows 3, at most 40 cells (8x5 a swarm); phoneCols 3 and phoneRows 4, at most 20; heroes 'auto' (the most detailed cells in front) | 'fixed' | a list of [col, row] nearest first; phoneHeroes 'auto'; perspective 1200 (700-2000), phonePerspective 900; depth 800 (600-3000), phoneDepth 600; near 280 (0-300), phoneNear 160; size 1.3 (0.6-1.8) the pieces' size in the cloud, phoneSize 1.5; twist 24 (0-45), 0 a flat glide like dealt cards; drift 0.06 (0-0.15); order 'centre' | 'sweep' | 'random'; blur false; flash 0 (0-0.3); handoff true (the poster grows to full bleed) | false (it rests framed); seed 11; phone 'same' | 'rest'.
